items.t: How Lower Oil Prices At American Airlines Group (AAL) Have Changed Its Investment Story
items.sum: American Airlines Group saw investor attention pick up after crude oil prices moved toward US$87 a barrel earlier this week, easing a key operating cost for carriers that rely heavily on jet fuel. The move in oil prices directly affects American Airlines Group's cost base, which is particularly important while the business is still managing a sizeable debt load and fuel-sensitive margins. items.t: United’s CEO Says He’s “100%” Sure an American Deal Could Be Approved
items.sum: Scott Kirby keeps pitching a rival that already slammed the door, and regulators are not the hurdle he fears most. With fuel costs squeezing every carrier, what is he really signaling, and who is the message meant for?
